The '''Sinharan T'sau''' was a [[Skyhook/Legends|skyhook]] which orbited the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It served as a private residence for the wealthy elite of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

The skyhook was the location of the [[Midnight Hall]], which served as the base of operations for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
